$comment: The second round of a repair loop: iteration 2, attempt 1. This is the case the four-part key of ADR-0021 §1 exists to distinguish. Without iteration it would be indistinguishable from a retry of iteration 1, and the idempotency key would suppress a tool call the workflow legitimately asked for a second time.
